product_overview: AgroHarvest is a multi-role agricultural marketplace that connects farmers, dealers, agents and customers to list and trade produce, manage inventory and deliveries, and view market trends.
core_goals: Allow users to register and sign in as farmer, dealer, agent, or customer.
Enable farmers to list products, manage incoming orders and contracts, and track earnings.
Enable dealers to manage inventory and track deliveries.
Allow agents to view and update delivery statuses for orders.
Provide a public marketplace for browsing products and placing orders with checkout and delivery address capture.
Surface live market price data (Kalimati Market) and let users view trends.

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Register a new account as a farmer, dealer, or agent by providing basic profile and location details.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill name -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Select role (farmer/dealer/agent) -> Select district -> Submit signup form -> See success message
Navigate to /signup -> Leave required field blank -> Submit signup form -> See validation error message

features.name: User Sign In
features.description: Authenticate to the platform using existing credentials and reach a role-specific dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /signin -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> Redirected to role-specific dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Fill email with incorrect credentials -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> See invalid credentials error

features.name: Farmer Dashboard
features.description: Farmers can view product and earnings summaries, list produce for sale, manage incoming orders and contracts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View dashboard stats (total products, orders, earnings) -> Add a new product -> Fill product details (name, yield, price, category, harvest date, image) -> Submit product listing -> See product in listed products
Navigate to /dashboard -> View listed products -> Delete a product -> See product removed from listed products
Navigate to /dashboard -> View incoming orders -> Accept an order -> See order status updated to accepted

Navigate to /dashboard -> Navigate to /earnings.html -> View earnings overview -> Navigate to /orders.html -> View orders list -> Navigate to /settings.html -> View settings -> Navigate to /market_trends.html -> View market trends -> Navigate to /marketplace.html -> Browse marketplace

features.name: Dealer Dashboard
features.description: Dealers manage inventory items and monitor delivery statuses related to their inventory and purchases.
user_flows: Navigate to /dealer_dashboard.html -> View inventory list -> Add new inventory item -> Fill inventory item details -> Submit inventory item -> See new item in inventory list
Navigate to /dealer_dashboard.html -> View inventory list -> Delete inventory item -> See item removed from inventory

Navigate to /dealer_dashboard.html -> View delivery status -> Navigate to /dealer_earnings.html -> View dealer earnings -> Navigate to /dealer_settings.html -> View dealer settings -> Navigate to /market_trends.html -> View market trends

features.name: Agent Dashboard
features.description: Agents access pending and in-transit orders and update delivery statuses as they progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /agent_dashboard.html -> View all pending and in-transit orders -> Update order status to Processing -> Update order status to Shipped -> Update order status to Delivered -> See order move through statuses
Navigate to /agent_dashboard.html -> View pending orders -> Update order status to Cancelled -> See order marked as cancelled
Navigate to /agent_dashboard.html -> Navigate to /market_trends.html -> View market trends

features.name: Marketplace
features.description: Browse available products by category, add items to a cart and continue to checkout to place orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /marketplace.html -> View all available products -> Filter products by category -> Add product to cart -> View cart -> Navigate to /checkout.html
Navigate to /marketplace.html -> Search or filter commodities -> Find matching product -> Add product to cart -> Navigate to /checkout.html

features.name: Checkout and Order Placement
features.description: Review cart contents, provide delivery address details, and place an order to be processed by sellers and agents.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout.html -> View cart items -> Fill delivery address -> Confirm and place order -> See order confirmation
Navigate to /checkout.html -> View cart items -> Leave required address field blank -> Confirm and place order -> See validation error about delivery address

features.name: Orders Management
features.description: View, filter, update and delete orders across roles that have order management access.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders.html -> View all orders list -> Filter orders by status -> Update order status -> See updated status in orders list
Navigate to /orders.html -> View all orders list -> Delete an order -> See order removed from list

features.name: Earnings Overview
features.description: View revenue summaries, pending earnings and recent order-related income for farmers and dealers.
user_flows: Navigate to /earnings.html -> View total revenue -> View pending amount -> View recent orders list
Navigate to /dealer_earnings.html -> View dealer total revenue -> View dealer pending amount -> View recent dealer orders

features.name: Live Market Trends
features.description: Display recent price data for commodities sourced from Kalimati Market to inform selling and buying decisions.
user_flows: Navigate to /market_trends.html -> View live price grid with min/max/avg prices -> Search or filter commodities -> See filtered price data

features.name: Settings
features.description: Let users view and update profile settings and toggle UI theme preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings.html -> View current settings -> Update profile information -> Submit changes -> See updated profile information
Navigate to /settings.html -> Toggle dark/light theme -> See theme applied
Navigate to /dealer_settings.html -> View dealer settings -> Update dealer profile information -> Submit changes -> See updated profile

tech_stack.other: HTML5 static pages served via Express

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is session-storage based, no real JWT tokens
known_limitations.impact: Sessions do not persist across browser sessions properly

known_limitations.issue: Market data proxy depends on external Kalimati API availability
known_limitations.impact: Market trends page may fail if external API is down

known_limitations.issue: Product images are stored as base64 strings directly in the database
known_limitations.impact: Large images may cause performance issues
